title: Let’s Think Green and Be Nature-wise

activities.title: I Wonder poem
activities.disposition: Optional playable poetry/listening enrichment; one bounded main-message item. Recitation remains classroom practice.
activities.editorialAction: Use figurative questions as language, not keyed scientific explanations; no copied lyrics in public source.

activities.title: Environment word bank and Armenian equivalents
activities.disposition: Contextual vocabulary Practice; natural Armenian support and accepted alternatives.
activities.editorialAction: Distinguish rubbish/litter and preserve/reserve; use protect nature. Translation alone is not core assessed reasoning.

activities.title: Environmental definitions
activities.disposition: Review and correct definitions before matching.
activities.editorialAction: Organic does not mean without any chemicals. Define the farming sense accurately; no absolute health/safety inference.

activities.title: Armenian to English environmental expressions
activities.disposition: Controlled vocabulary variants with clear contexts.
activities.editorialAction: Allow legitimate equivalents; distinguish dropping litter from disposing of waste.

activities.title: Water problems
activities.disposition: Contextual classification using supplied information.
activities.editorialAction: Make categories non-overlapping; infected water and pollution otherwise overlap. No outside health knowledge required.

activities.title: Be the One Who Saves the Earth
activities.disposition: First corrected shared reading source, three Practice questions.
activities.editorialAction: Supply the missing question list. Qualify water/energy advice; remove absolute bath/shower claims.

activities.title: Environmental actions rhyme/song
activities.disposition: Optional real recording; one main-message item outside core readiness.
activities.editorialAction: No singing or personal-habit score. Review the actual recording and intended use.

activities.title: Should and should not
activities.disposition: Advice in explicit scenarios; scaffold should/ought to, distinguish advice from obligation.
activities.editorialAction: Do not make walking to school an unconditional safety or moral requirement.

activities.title: How green am I?
activities.disposition: Keep unscored reflection, with invented situations permitted.
activities.editorialAction: Discard arbitrary champion points; do not grade income, purchases, appliance ownership or personal disclosures.

activities.title: List environmental actions
activities.disposition: Short planning practice for advice/reasons; classroom or self-check writing.
activities.editorialAction: Does not substitute for the natural-wonder essay. No additional mandatory teacher submission.

activities.title: Tropical Rainforests
activities.disposition: Second corrected shared reading source, three Practice questions.
activities.editorialAction: Remove conflicting surface percentages, unqualified loss rates/species counts, oxygen-lungs and universal canopy claims. Keys must follow the corrected text.

activities.title: Endanger, recycle, affect
activities.disposition: Contextual word forms; passive and -ing support.
activities.editorialAction: Explicit time/subject; reuse Unit 2 passive evidence instead of claiming new grammar coverage.

activities.title: Reuse, reforestation, deforestation
activities.disposition: Contrast taught meanings with explicit actions.
activities.editorialAction: Avoid tautological options and count repeats as Practice variants.

activities.title: Compound nouns and adjectives
activities.disposition: Taught compounds in bounded contexts; correct matching cardinality.
activities.editorialAction: The original asks for as many combinations as possible; it is not a one-to-one matching key.

activities.title: Rainforest true/false
activities.disposition: Use the same corrected rainforest source family as activity 11.
activities.editorialAction: Statements not supported by the passage are not keyed as factual truth; no extra independent source credit.

activities.title: Environmental interviews and debate
activities.disposition: Retain publisher interview for three Practice questions; debate classroom-assessed.
activities.editorialAction: No Unit 3 script is present in pp.144–146. Transcript/audition/alignment and private registration remain pending; do not invent answers.

activities.title: Prefixes
activities.disposition: Infer taught prefix meaning in an explicit example and word meaning.
activities.editorialAction: Prefix senses depend on the word. Compare with Unit 1 suffix/form bank.

activities.title: Read opinions and add your own
activities.disposition: Corrected discussion/reading rehearsal in guide; distinguish claims, reasons and supported evidence.
activities.editorialAction: Do not present denial of human-caused warming as an equally supported scientific account. No score for personal agreement.

activities.title: Environmental translation revision
activities.disposition: Intentional vocabulary retrieval variants within the same budget.
activities.editorialAction: No new outcome merely because the direction of translation changes.

activities.title: A Great Day Out cartoon
activities.disposition: Preserve ten panels in row order; optional classroom narrative and picnic advice.
activities.editorialAction: Visually inspected: searching for a clean picnic spot ends with the family leaving its own litter. Provide an accessible scene description; do not infer motives or universal fire law.

activities.title: Wonders of the World Nature
activities.disposition: Two shared Practice readings, each with three questions; keep profiles 1–3 then 4–7.
activities.editorialAction: Remove moralistic opening and unsupported Rio-largest-bay claim. Everest highest above sea level. Photo recognition is optional and requires verified image/alt-text pairings.

activities.title: Natural wonders table
activities.disposition: Supply fact cards for all twelve listed places; use them for guided reading and W01 choice.
activities.editorialAction: Five entries have no profile in activity 21. Do not require outside geography knowledge or travel; correct Arizona spelling.

activities.title: What a Wonderful World
activities.disposition: Optional real recording; one main-message item outside core readiness.
activities.editorialAction: No lyric memorisation, singing grade or full public lyric reproduction; asset-specific review remains.

activities.title: Noun/adjective/verb table
activities.disposition: Natural word forms in controlled sentences.
activities.editorialAction: Not every root has a common form in each column; accept legitimate forms and avoid invented words.

activities.title: Grammar revision
activities.disposition: All 23 printed subprompts mapped below; teach zero conditional explicitly before assessed use.
activities.editorialAction: Use stable 25.intro plus 25.01–25.22. The first printed 18 is not the later 18; repair ambiguity and exclude untaught periphrastic forms from core assessment.

activity25Subprompts.action: Use if plus statement word order; related Unit 1 reported-question extension. Not annual reported orders/requests.

activity25Subprompts.focus: Are to be / can be saved
activity25Subprompts.action: Both can be grammatical; rewrite explicit meaning. Do not assess advanced be-to obligation as core.
Competing grammatical perception constructions; omit from automatic bank.
Teach/remind before optional practice; no new core gate.
Repair near/all alternatives in a meaningful supplied context.
Remove unsupported ant comparison; give intended communicative meaning.
Do not add an untaught ocean-density premise to fill a slot.
Remove unqualified 75% claim; not a scientific calculation item.
Keep ought to as a complete construction; distinguish advice and obligation by explicit purpose.
Both can be grammatical; do not force a unique key on the original.
Give a clear general-time context before conditional work.
Teach contrast through a complete sentence; no spelling-only new reasoning claim.
Clarify whether reused intact or processed into material; original list is insufficient.
Reuse Unit 2 G04 distinction; no new core outcome.
Explicit event overlap; preserve Unit 2 past-aspect coverage and valid alternatives.
Replace moralistic destruction claim with supplied general relationship.
Separate condition/result without equating environmental choices with humanity.
No claim that a person cannot love humans if they do not love nature.
Assess recommendation, not compulsory agreement with a moral proposition.
Contextual article use, related to Unit 1 S08; not geography recall.
Remove universal peaceful-coexistence claim. New programme lists present perfect in Grade 6; it is prior-learning revision, not a new Grade 7 core target.
Preserve supplied location; passive repeats Unit 2 S05.
Explicit amount frame; no extra automatic core target.

outcomes.disposition: S01/S02; controlled contextual language, not moral judgments.
Corrected supplied information in activities 5/6/11/16/18; assess English evidence rather than unintroduced science.
Activities 21/22 and original nature texts/audio; give all necessary information.
S03/S04/S05; explicit lesson scaffolding. Other revision remains supporting or optional.

outcomes.summary: Understand the main meaning of reasonably paced media about the planet as a wonder
outcomes.disposition: Two new Practice recordings about natural wonders plus ten original assessed recordings; environmental interview alone is insufficient.

outcomes.summary: Understand the main content of simple informational texts about the planet as a wonder
outcomes.disposition: S06/S07, including natural-wonder profiles and new assessed sources.

outcomes.summary: Prepared environmental presentation including technological effects and cause/effect
outcomes.disposition: Classroom speaking; supply corrected factual support. No automatic speaking score.

outcomes.summary: Discuss a familiar/community environmental issue with reasons and possible improvements
outcomes.disposition: Classroom interaction; optional written rehearsal does not replace oral evidence.

outcomes.summary: Write a simple informational essay introducing a natural wonder and explaining the choice
outcomes.disposition: W01, 80–100 words with supplied fact cards. Natural wonder, not a compulsory built monument.

outcomes.summary: Value responsible everyday behaviour towards the planet
outcomes.disposition: Supported reflection; no personal habit, purchasing power or attitude score.
Optional extension; natural-wonder content remains core.

outcomes.summary: Prepared world-wonder presentation in material/intangible heritage context
outcomes.disposition: Optional classroom work; no extra automatic mastery requirement.

programmeCrosswalk.2026_L3: Adds explicit technological impact and cause/effect in prepared presentation.
programmeCrosswalk.2026_natural_vs_world: Natural wonders mandatory; wider world-wonder knowledge/presentation additional.
